therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Adults with active Crohn's disease who completed the 6-week double-blind main study (NCT00291668)
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Percentage of CDAI responders at Week 26

results.effect_size: CDAI responder rate at Week 26: 44.4% (prior placebo arm), 73.3% (prior CZP 200 mg arm), 60.0% (prior CZP 400 mg arm)
results.target_engagement_evidence: CRP levels declined from baseline across all arms during the extension period
biomarker_changes: CRP geometric mean at Week 26: 15.94 mg/L (prior placebo), 9.96 mg/L (prior CZP 200 mg), 13.11 mg/L (prior CZP 400 mg) vs baseline geometric means of ~21-26 mg/L
CRP ratio at Week 26 to Week 0: 0.63 (prior placebo), 0.40 (prior CZP 200 mg), 0.47 (prior CZP 400 mg)
subgroup_findings: CDAI responder rate at Week 26 was highest in the prior CZP 200 mg arm (73.3%) vs prior placebo (44.4%) and prior CZP 400 mg (60.0%)
Remission rate at Week 26: 22.2% (prior placebo), 46.7% (prior CZP 200 mg), 46.7% (prior CZP 400 mg)
70-point responder rate at Week 26: 55.6% (prior placebo), 73.3% (prior CZP 200 mg), 73.3% (prior CZP 400 mg)
safety_signals: Serious adverse events included Crohn's disease exacerbation (8/40 overall), ileal perforation (1/9 in prior placebo arm), peritonitis (1/9 in prior placebo arm), pancreatitis (1/15 in prior CZP 200 mg arm), pyrexia (1/16 in prior CZP 400 mg arm), suicidal ideation (1/16 in prior CZP 400 mg arm)

dose_info.schedule: every 4 weeks (Weeks 8, 12, 16, 20, 24 relative to main study start)

context.comparator: No separate placebo arm in extension; all arms received CZP 400 mg maintenance; arms differ by prior induction treatment (placebo, CZP 200 mg, or CZP 400 mg in main study)
context.duration: 18 weeks (extension study); 26 weeks total from main study start

subgroups.raw_descriptor: Percentage of subjects not in remission

results_by_chain.population_description: Active Crohn's disease patients who received placebo induction in main study, then CZP 400 mg maintenance
Active Crohn's disease patients who received CZP 200 mg induction in main study, then CZP 400 mg maintenance
Active Crohn's disease patients who received CZP 400 mg induction in main study, then CZP 400 mg maintenance
